name: pi-vibeguard
notes: Forked from aizigao/pi-vibeguard (npm @aizigao/pi-vibeguard v0.1.2). The Mapping View contract lives in openspec (spec vibeguard-mapping-view).

knownDebt.reason: [artifact] Diff-alignment artifact on a repeated closing brace: the raw diff pairs `-}` with `+}` while `git diff -w` renders `}` as unchanged context; the file is otherwise at upstream bytes.
[policy] Explicit fork changelog routing/packaging and dual-history navigation distinguish independent release sequences. Retain until upstream offers an equivalent fork-aware packaging contract.

reapplyOnSync: keep the packaging divergence: npm name @xzzpig/pi-vibeguard, the repository field repointed to xzzpig/pi-extensions, and the @earendil-works/pi-tui peerDependency (range aligned with pi-tool-display) plus the vitest devDep

keep the fork-only modules mapping-view.ts, category-picker.ts, suspension-filter.ts, suspension-state.ts (SuspensionState + sanitizeCategory + status sync) and fork-commands.ts (the six /vibeguard:* registrations); index.ts keeps the imports, the extension factory state and one registerVibeguardCommands(pi, deps) call

keep the tsconfig include widening (tests, allowImportingTsExtensions) with test-engine.ts excluded from typecheck, and keep eslint ignoring test-engine.ts since typed linting requires tsconfig membership
keep the README fork notice and the FORK-CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry

Keep pi.changelogPath pointing to ./FORK-CHANGELOG.md, ship the fork log and any upstream changelog, and retain README release-history navigation. Never append fork releases to the upstream log; follow docs/fork-changelogs.md.
doNotReintroduce: do not thread the suspension skip-params through redactText/redactDeep/redactMessageContent: those three engine functions stay byte-identical to upstream, and the call-site PatternSet filter (suspension-filter.ts) replaces that threading
Do not mix fork release headings into the upstream changelog or use upstream history as the Pi startup changelog.
